summary: Tested Centralized Unit Management module for GHG platform. All 6 requested features verified working. Backend API tests: 19/20 passed. Frontend UI tests: All passed. Minor data consistency issue found where some fuel's allowed_units use 'tonne' instead of symbol 't'.

minor.issue: Some existing fuels have 'tonne' in allowed_units instead of the symbol 't'. Frontend handles this via unitsMatch() function with aliases.

issues: Warning shows 'No conversion defined for mL' - Super Admin may need to define unit conversions in Formula Parameters for all volume units

units_seed_defaults.details: POST /api/units/seed-defaults creates 4 mass units (kg, g, t, lb) + 6 volume units (L, mL, kL, m³, gal, ft³) = 10 total units

unit_structure.details: Each unit has: id, symbol, name, unit_type (mass/volume), aliases[], is_base_unit, conversion_to_base. kg is mass base (1.0), L is volume base (1.0)

fuel_database_uses_units.details: Fuel Database 'Add Fuel' dialog shows 'Allowed Quantity Units' section with Mass Units (kg, g, t, lb) and Volume Units (L, mL, kL, m³, gal, ft³) checkboxes. Fuels can save allowed_units field.

emissions_unit_filtering.details: Emissions page quantity dropdown shows 10 units from centralized module. When fuel has allowed_units, dropdown filters to only show allowed units (via unitsMatch() function).

volume_unit_detection.details: isVolumeUnit() function uses centralized units with aliases. When mL (volume) selected, warning shows: 'Density required for volume-to-mass conversion'. Uses centralized unit aliases for detection.

density_conditional_formula.details: CO2 formula expression shows 'Density (if volume)' condition. Density is included in calculation for volume units, skipped for mass units. Formula components support 'always', 'volume_units', 'mass_units' conditions.

action_items: Consider adding mL → kg conversion in Formula Parameters for complete volume unit support
Minor: Update existing fuels that have 'tonne' in allowed_units to use 't' symbol for consistency (optional - frontend handles this via aliases)
critical_code_review_comments: Good: DEFAULT_UNITS in server.py correctly defines 4 mass + 6 volume units with proper conversion factors
Good: UnitCreate/UnitResponse models include symbol, name, unit_type, aliases, conversion_to_base fields
Good: POST /api/units/seed-defaults only creates units that don't already exist (prevents duplicates)
Good: Frontend Units.js displays units with symbol, name, conversion factor, aliases, and Base indicator
Good: Frontend FuelDatabase.js fetches units from API and displays Mass/Volume checkboxes for allowed_units
Good: Frontend Emissions.js uses isVolumeUnit() function with centralized unit aliases for volume detection
Good: Frontend Emissions.js availableQuantityUnits filters by fuel's allowed_units using unitsMatch() function
Good: Formula components support 'condition' field for conditional density application

success_rate.backend: 95% (19/20 tests passed - 1 minor data consistency test failed)

seed_data_creation: TEST_Unit_Fuel and TEST_Custom_Unit created/deleted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Centralized Unit Management module is fully functional. Units are stored in 'units' collection with 10 default units (4 mass, 6 volume). Fuel Database uses allowed_units to restrict quantity unit options. Emissions page uses isVolumeUnit() with centralized aliases and formula conditions ('always', 'volume_units', 'mass_units') for Density application.
